contestants.motive: Keep conversations light, compare what people say, and avoid becoming the obvious target.

contestants.name: Riley Johnson
contestants.motive: Turn careful observation into one reliable partnership and a well-timed competition win.

houseEvents.title: The Last Stand
houseEvents.narrative: Riley Johnson has made it clear — you are the target this week. The votes are stacking up against you. You have one last chance to flip the house before eviction night.

choices.label: Make a desperate deal
choices.description: Offer them whatever it takes to get through the week.

choices.label: Win the veto
choices.description: Stop negotiating and go and take it off the table yourself.

choices.label: Accept your fate gracefully
choices.description: Stop fighting it, and be remembered for how you went out.

houseEvents.title: In the house
houseEvents.narrative: Maya Hassan and Riley Johnson are deep in strategy talk in the kitchen.

houseEvents.title: The Revelation
houseEvents.narrative: Through the wall you hear Riley Johnson explaining your plan - your plan - to people who were never meant to hear it. They walk out smiling, unaware you were on the other side.

choices.label: Confront them privately
choices.description: Say it to their face, with nobody else in the room.

choices.label: Use it against them
choices.description: Say nothing, and spend what you know when it is worth most.
